1. Check that the hot/cold mold setting conditions are correct and follow the PFC
2. When placing upper into the mold, ensure the heel/heel pull tab is straight and aligned with the center of the laser. The heel must reach the mold’s positioning stopper. The upper should be clamped and pulled tight to fit snugly to the mold.
3. After BPM, check that the heel and heel pull tab are straight, the collar is smooth, collar lining isn’t wrinkled or has glue overflow. The molded heel should have a 3D curve matching the sample shoe.
Due to material characteristics, a slight wrinkle on the collar lining is acceptable as shown in the updated QA manual.
